title: 第八百八十七章 宣战第八百八十六章 三王结盟 乱星合力
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始
content_zh:
“血垣天极阵？”
听到三人道出的名词，顾尘风虽然陌生，却也猜到，这应该是某种强大的禁制。
殷红鸾继续解释道：“这是上界的一种特殊禁制，乃是我族秘传之术。
可结合天地自然的规则，因地制宜，建造此阵。”
殷红鸾追忆道：“数千年前，整个乱星域只有这一座顶级矿脉，三大王城都驻扎在一处。
虽然大家制定了规则，约法三章，但因为人员混杂，种族不同，依旧矛盾频发。
为了化解这种局面，本王观察了整座矿脉，最终制定出方案。
这座矿脉可以分作血垣天极阵的‘三极’，利用天然阵法之道，开山裂地。
将矿脉一分为三，随后再借助地脉之力，运走大山，令三大王城彼此相隔万里。
这才能够各自统御一方，至今相安无事。”
听了殷红鸾的讲述，顾尘风不禁有些震惊。
对方不愧是来自上界的生灵，居然有如此玄妙手段，在禁法之地移山填海。
震惊过后，顾尘风不禁发问：“殷道友，你的意思是，咱们可以利用这座大阵，抗衡天圣城的攻势？”
殷红鸾点头，“不错，血垣天极阵最大的功效，便是利用天地自然之力，形成天然屏障。
每一极，就是一个阵眼。
三大王城就是此阵的三个阵眼，下方的血晶矿脉，则是大阵的能量源泉。
这三座阵眼的控制权，就掌控在我们三人手中。
平日里，我们各自为政，相安无事，但若是乱星域遭到外部威胁。
只要三座阵眼激发，大阵随时便可启动。
正因如此，天圣城那帮家伙才不敢轻举妄动，正面进攻乱星域。

转而想从内部，瓦解我们其中一极。”
说罢，殷红鸾看向冥九幽、姬千秋。
“两位道友，事到如今，我们也没有退路了。
既然天圣城不给我们活路，那就和他们正面碰一碰，看看谁能笑到最后！”
“好，我们即刻回城，开启阵眼！”
二王同时点头，眼中也燃起了熊熊战意。
……
数日后。
乱星域境内，一则爆炸性消息传出。
天圣城方面，公开囤积大军，正式对乱星域宣战。
消息一出，宛如惊雷炸响。
彻底震动了这座沉寂万年，拥有独立规则的夺圣之地。
content_en:
"Xueyuan Tianji Formation?"
Hearing the nouns spoken by the three people, although Gu Chenfeng was unfamiliar with them, he guessed that they should be some kind of powerful restriction.
Yin Hongluan continued to explain: "This is a special restriction in the upper world, and it is a secret technique of our clan.
This formation can be built according to the natural rules of heaven and earth and according to local conditions. "
Yin Hongluan recalled: "Thousands of years ago, there was only this top-level mineral vein in the entire Chaotic Star Territory, and the three major royal cities were all stationed in one place.
Although everyone has formulated rules and agreed on three chapters, conflicts still occur frequently because of the mixed personnel and different races.
In order to resolve this situation, I observed the entire mine and finally formulated a plan.
This mineral vein can be divided into the 'three poles' of the Bloody Wall Heavenly Pole Formation, using the natural formation method to open mountains and crack the earth.
Divide the ore vein into three, and then use the power of the vein to transport the mountains, so that the three royal cities are thousands of miles apart from each other.
Only then can each of them rule one side, and so far they are in peace. "
After listening to Yin Hongluan's story, Gu Chenfeng couldn't help but be a little shocked.
The other party is indeed a creature from the upper world, and he actually has such mysterious means to move mountains and fill seas in forbidden places.
After being shocked, Gu Chenfeng couldn't help but ask: "Fellow Daoist Yin, do you mean that we can use this formation to counter the Tiansheng City's offensive?"
Yin Hongluan nodded, "Yes, the greatest effect of the Xueyuan Tianji Formation is to use the natural power of heaven and earth to form a natural barrier.
Each pole is a formation eye.
The three royal cities are the three eyes of this formation, and the blood crystal veins below are the energy source of the formation.
The control of these three formations is in the hands of the three of us.
On weekdays, we all work on our own and live in peace and harmony, but if the Chaos Star Territory is threatened by an external force.
As long as the three formation eyes are activated, the formation can be activated at any time.
Because of this, the guys in Tiansheng City did not dare to act rashly and attack the Chaotic Star Territory head-on.
Instead, we want to dismantle one of our poles from within. "
After saying that, Yin Hongluan looked at Ming Jiuyou and Ji Qianqiu.
"Two fellow Taoists, at this point, we have no way out.
Since Tiansheng City doesn't give us a way to survive, let's face them head-on and see who can have the last laugh! "
"Okay, let's go back to the city immediately and open the formation eyes!"
The two kings nodded at the same time, their eyes burning with fighting spirit.
…
A few days later.
Within the Chaotic Star Territory, an explosive news came out.
As for Tiansheng City, they openly amassed troops and officially declared war on the Chaos Star Territory.
As soon as the news came out, it was like thunder exploding.
It completely shook this sacred place that had been silent for thousands of years and had independent rules.
